ops.text: Read through the bit-growth law of Veldhuis et al. (2026), under which the bits a Mamba state needs to keep its predictions at a fixed quality rise by 0.62 per doubling of the context, a gain of 0.25 bits corresponds to a decoded horizon about $2^{0.25/0.62}\approx 1.32$ times longer at unchanged damage.

new_bib.text: J. Veldhuis, F. Postma, R. Zwart, and M. Dekkers (2026). How many bits does a recurrent state need? Context-length scaling of state precision in Mamba and gated linear attention. arXiv preprint.
